│      u_char *ph, *p, *tmp;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      int l, phlen;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      ASN1_TYPE *tostr;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      SpcAttributeTypeAndOptionalValue *aval;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      ASN1_TYPE *taval;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      SpcSerializedObject *so;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      SpcLink *link;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      STACK_OF(ASN1_TYPE) *oset, *aset;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      ph = pe_page_hash_calc(&phlen, ctx, phtype);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      if (!ph) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          fprintf(stderr, "Failed to calculate page hash\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          return NULL; /* FAILED */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      if (ctx->options->verbose)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          print_hash("Calculated page hash            ", "", ph, phlen);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      else                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          print_hash("Calculated page hash            ", "...", ph, (phlen < 32) ? phlen : 32);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      tostr = ASN1_TYPE_new();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      tostr->type = V_ASN1_OCTET_STRING;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      tostr->value.octet_string = ASN1_OCTET_STRING_new();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      ASN1_OCTET_STRING_set(tostr->value.octet_string, ph, phlen);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      OPENSSL_free(ph);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      oset = sk_ASN1_TYPE_new_null();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      sk_ASN1_TYPE_push(oset, tostr);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      l = i2d_ASN1_SET_ANY(oset, NULL);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      tmp = p = OPENSSL_malloc((size_t)l);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      i2d_ASN1_SET_ANY(oset, &tmp);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      ASN1_TYPE_free(tostr);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      sk_ASN1_TYPE_free(oset);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      aval = SpcAttributeTypeAndOptionalValue_new();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      aval->type = OBJ_txt2obj((phtype == NID_sha1) ?                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              SPC_PE_IMAGE_PAGE_HASHES_V1 : SPC_PE_IMAGE_PAGE_HASHES_V2, 1);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      aval->value = ASN1_TYPE_new();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      aval->value->type = V_ASN1_SET;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      aval->value->value.set = ASN1_STRING_new();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      ASN1_STRING_set(aval->value->value.set, p, l);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      OPENSSL_free(p);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      l = i2d_SpcAttributeTypeAndOptionalValue(aval, NULL);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      tmp = p = OPENSSL_malloc((size_t)l);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      i2d_SpcAttributeTypeAndOptionalValue(aval, &tmp);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      SpcAttributeTypeAndOptionalValue_free(aval);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      taval = ASN1_TYPE_new();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      taval->type = V_ASN1_SEQUENCE;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      taval->value.sequence = ASN1_STRING_new();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      ASN1_STRING_set(taval->value.sequence, p, l);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      OPENSSL_free(p);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      aset = sk_ASN1_TYPE_new_null();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      sk_ASN1_TYPE_push(aset, taval);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      l = i2d_ASN1_SET_ANY(aset, NULL);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      tmp = p = OPENSSL_malloc((size_t)l);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      l = i2d_ASN1_SET_ANY(aset, &tmp);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      ASN1_TYPE_free(taval);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      sk_ASN1_TYPE_free(aset);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      so = SpcSerializedObject_new();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      ASN1_OCTET_STRING_set(so->classId, classid_page_hash, sizeof classid_page_hash);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      ASN1_OCTET_STRING_set(so->serializedData, p, l);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      OPENSSL_free(p);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      link = SpcLink_new();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      link->type = 1;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      link->value.moniker = so;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      return link;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * Print current and calculated PE checksum,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│   * check if the signature exists.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│   * [in, out] ctx: structure holds input and output data                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│   * [returns] 0 on error or 1 on success                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│   */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  static int pe_check_file(FILE_FORMAT_CTX *ctx)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      uint32_t real_pe_checksum, sum = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      if (ctx == NULL || ctx->pe_ctx == NULL || ctx->options == NULL                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          || ctx->options->indata == NULL) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          fprintf(stderr, "Init error\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          return 0; /* FAILED */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      real_pe_checksum = pe_calc_realchecksum(ctx);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      if (ctx->pe_ctx->pe_checksum == real_pe_checksum) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          printf("PE checksum   : %08X\n", real_pe_checksum);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      } else {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          printf("Current PE checksum   : %08X\n", ctx->pe_ctx->pe_checksum);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          printf("Calculated PE checksum: %08X\n", real_pe_checksum);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          printf("Warning: invalid PE checksum\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      /* Signature directory bounds */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      if (ctx->pe_ctx->sigpos == 0 || ctx->pe_ctx->siglen == 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          || ctx->pe_ctx->sigpos > ctx->pe_ctx->fileend                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          || ctx->pe_ctx->siglen > ctx->pe_ctx->fileend - ctx->pe_ctx->sigpos) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          fprintf(stderr, "No signature found\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          return 0; /* FAILED */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│       * Validate WIN_CERTIFICATE chain.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│       * If the sum of the rounded dwLength values does not equal the Size value,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│       * then either the attribute certificate table or the Size field is corrupted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│       */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      while (sum < ctx->pe_ctx->siglen) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          uint32_t len, off;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          /* Prevent overflow in sigpos + sum */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          if (sum > UINT32_MAX - ctx->pe_ctx->sigpos) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              fprintf(stderr, "Corrupted attribute certificate table\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              return 0; /* FAILED */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          off = ctx->pe_ctx->sigpos + sum;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          /* Need at least 4 bytes to read dwLength */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          if (off > ctx->pe_ctx->fileend || ctx->pe_ctx->fileend - off < 4) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              fprintf(stderr, "Corrupted attribute certificate table\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              return 0; /* FAILED */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          len = GET_UINT32_LE(ctx->options->indata + off);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          /* dwLength must include the 8-byte WIN_CERTIFICATE header */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          if (len < 8 || len > ctx->pe_ctx->siglen - sum || len > ctx->pe_ctx->fileend - off) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              fprintf(stderr, "Corrupted attribute certificate table\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              return 0; /* FAILED */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          /* Quadword align data */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          if (len % 8) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              uint32_t pad = 8 - (len % 8);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              /* Ensure quadword alignment does not overflow or exceed remaining table size */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              if (pad > ctx->pe_ctx->siglen - sum - len) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  fprintf(stderr, "Corrupted attribute certificate table\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                  return 0; /* FAILED */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              len += pad;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          sum += len;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      if (sum != ctx->pe_ctx->siglen) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          fprintf(stderr, "Corrupted attribute certificate table\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          fprintf(stderr, "Attribute certificate table size  : %08X\n", ctx->pe_ctx->siglen);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          fprintf(stderr, "Sum of the rounded dwLength values: %08X\n\n", sum);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          return 0; /* FAILED */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      return 1; /* OK */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ✅ Agent Final Answer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Agent: Security Analyzer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Final Answer:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  1. Vulnerability type: Integer Underflow in Array Index Calculation and Memory Access                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  2. CWE-ID: CWE-190 (Integer Overflow or Wraparound) — specifically manifesting as signed-integer underflow during pointer arithmetic, leading to out-of-bounds memory access (CWE-125 out-of-bounds read is secondary but closely tied).                                                                                                              │
│  3. Vulnerable line(s) or code region:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│     - Line 1329: `if (ctx == NULL || ctx->pe_ctx == NULL || ctx->options == NULL || ctx->options->indata == NULL) {`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - Line 1344: `|| ctx->pe_ctx->siglen > ctx->pe_ctx->fileend - ctx->pe_ctx->sigpos) {`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     - Line 1364: `if (off > ctx->pe_ctx->fileend || ctx->pe_ctx->fileend - off < 4) {`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│     - Line 1371: `if (len < 8 || len > ctx->pe_ctx->siglen - sum || len > ctx->pe_ctx->fileend - off) {`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│     - Line 1381: `if (pad > ctx->pe_ctx->siglen - sum - len) {`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│     - Line 1381–1383: `if (pad > ctx->pe_ctx->siglen - sum - len) { ... return 0; }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  4. Root cause explanation:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│     - Multiple raw unsigned 32-bit integer subtractions occur *without prior lower-bound validation* on the operands (e.g., `fileend - off`, `siglen - sum`, `siglen - sum - len`).                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     - In languages like C, unsigned integer subtraction underflows silently (wraps to large positive value), causing safety checks like `siglen - sum < 0` to always pass, or `fileend - off` to yield a huge value instead of detecting invalid offsets.                                                                                              │
│     - Crucially, `off` is an unvalidated 32-bit offset (read earlier via `off = ctx->pe_ctx->sigpos + sum`). If `off > fileend`, then `fileend - off` underflows, making `fileend - off < 4` false even when `off` is far beyond the buffer end. This enables out-of-bounds reads in `GET_UINT32_LE(ctx->options->indata + off)` at line 1368, which   │
│  accesses `ctx->options->indata + off` with a large (underflowed) offset.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     - The `indata` pointer is not validated for bounds *before* being used in arithmetic (`indata + off`), and the subtraction `fileend - off` occurs *before* confirming `off <= fileend`. This combination allows attackers to supply PE files where `sigpos + sum` exceeds `fileend`, evading bounds checks and causing heap(buffer) overread or    │
│  invalid memory access.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  5. Relevant input-to-sink or input-to-dangerous-operation flow:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│     - Attacker-controlled PE file → parsed by `pe_check_file()` → sets `ctx->pe_ctx->sigpos`, `ctx->pe_ctx->siglen`, `ctx->pe_ctx->fileend`                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│     - Loop starts with `sum = 0`, computes `off = ctx->pe_ctx->sigpos + sum`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     - `ctx->pe_ctx->fileend - off` is computed *without* checking `off <= fileend`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - If `off > fileend`, subtraction underflows → large unsigned value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│     - Check `ctx->pe_ctx->fileend - off < 4` evaluates to `false` (e.g., 0xfffffffc < 4 is false for 32-bit)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     - Then `GET_UINT32_LE(ctx->options->indata + off)` reads 4 bytes at `indata + off`, where `off` is huge (due to underflow), leading to out-of-bounds read.                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  6. Security impact:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     - **Confidentiality breach**: Out-of-bounds read may leak sensitive in-memory data (e.g., heap contents, other structures, credentials).                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     - **Denial of service**: Crash via segfault or abort if accessing unmapped address.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│     - **Potential for RCE**: In rare cases, controlled heap layout + precise offset may enable information leak + side-channel exploitation (e.g., heap spray + controlled read), though this is secondary and less direct.                                                                                                                            │
│  7. Severity: HIGH                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - Directly enables arbitrary out-of-bounds read from attacker-controlled input; no authentication or user interaction required beyond supplying a malicious PE file (e.g., PE file with invalid certificate table).                                                                                                                                │
│  8. Tool evidence used:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│     - **planner (CWE-191 / CWE-125 hints)**: Flagged multiple raw subtractions in conditionals (`fileend - off`, `siglen - sum`, etc.) lacking lower-bound validation.                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│     - **CodeQL MCP (cpp/integer-overflow)**: Detected chained subtractions in argument lists with tokens like `data`, `len`, and `data + off` used without prior `>= left` checks.                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     - **CodeQL MCP (cpp/buffer-overflow)**: Identified `GET_UINT32_LE(... + off)` where `off` is derived from unchecked `sigpos + sum` and `fileend - off` underflowed.                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  9. Confidence level: HIGH                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│     - All identified vulnerabilities are *present in the visible code* and conform to standard C integer underflow behavior (ISO/IEC 9899:1999, §6.3.1.3).                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│     - The flaw is not mitigated by surrounding logic (e.g., no clamping or signed widening), and the underflow is *silent* at runtime.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│     - Multiple independent subtractions (`fileend - off`, `siglen - sum`, `siglen - sum - len`) are vulnerable *without additional checks*.                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

│  static u_char *pe_digest_calc(FILE_FORMAT_CTX *ctx, const EVP_MD *md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │

│  /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

│   * [out] hash: message digest BIO                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│  static int pe_process_data(FILE_FORMAT_CTX *ctx, BIO *hash, BIO *outdata)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│          fprintf(stderr, "Unable to modify file header\n");                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │

│      }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │

│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│  /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

│   */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  static PKCS7 *pe_pkcs7_signature_new(FILE_FORMAT_CTX *ctx, BIO *hash)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  /*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * Append signature to the outfile.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│   * [in, out] ctx: structure holds input and output data (unused)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   * [out] outdata: outdata file BIO                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   * [in] p7: PKCS#7 signature                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│   * [returns] 1 on error or 0 on success                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│   */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  static int pe_append_pkcs7(FILE_FORMAT_CTX *ctx, BIO *outdata, PKCS7 *p7)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      u_char *p = NULL;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      int len;       /* signature length */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      int padlen;    /* signature padding length */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      u_char buf[] = {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      };                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      /* squash the unused parameter warning */                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      (void)ctx;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      if (((len = i2d_PKCS7(p7, NULL)) <= 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          || (p = OPENSSL_malloc((size_t)len)) == NULL) {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          fprintf(stderr, "i2d_PKCS memory allocation failed: %d\n", len);                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
